$comment: Ratchet baseline for check-email-send-gated.mjs. Each key is an UNGATED sendEmail/sendBatchEmails call site (<file>:<line>) that is NOT preceded by an isSuppressed() check in its function. The list may only SHRINK. To clear an entry: gate the send (add isSuppressed) and remove the line, then run node scripts/check-email-send-gated.mjs --write. NEVER add a new entry to silence a new send, gate it instead. kind=internal: a genuinely-internal or transactional send (broker alert, admin notice, the broker's own digest) with no lead recipient to suppress; permanently allowlisted. kind=lead-todo: a lead or client-facing send that SHOULD be gated; Wave 5 fixes it and prunes the entry.
